sentence: This project runs a shared core that makes and stores genetically altered mice for research on diabetes, obesity and metabolic disorders.
This project tries to find out how a pathogen of the female reproductive tract interacts with its human host.
This project tests whether long-term exposure to house dust mites causes lung inflammation and mutations that raise lung cancer risk in never smokers.
This project studies how fat cells that break down fat control lipid metabolism in the liver through the glucocorticoid receptor.
This project builds a human tandem-chip platform that models cytokine release syndrome and neurotoxicity caused by T cell–engaging cancer immunotherapies.
This project develops natural language processing methods that find information about rigor and transparency in reports of randomized clinical trials.
This project tries to find out how esophageal adenocarcinoma starts and keeps growing, focusing on how stem cells are regulated.
This project studies how malaria keeps spreading in Cameroon by following groups of people over time and studying mosquitoes in different regions.
This project tests whether transcription factors that rejuvenate aged human fibroblast cells also work in cells aged inside the human body and in mouse liver.
This project mines RNA sequencing data from the nucleus accumbens of HIV-infected mice that took opioids to find neuron populations that respond.
This project brings computer-based methods such as systems science, data science and AI into community health research on health disparities.
This project studies how nuclease enzymes, which degrade nucleic acids, are controlled and how they pick their targets.
This project develops engineered stem cell-derived beta cells paired with engineered regulatory T cells that protect them from immune attack in type 1 diabetes.
This project tests how well methods that predict macromolecular structure perform.
This project examines whether speech, voice signals and sleep measures can predict mild cognitive impairment in older adults.
This project studies how depression develops over time in adolescent girls with autism and which social and emotional factors raise or lower the risk.
This project develops transcranial functional ultrasound for adult humans, including signal processing, a dual array transducer and a custom imaging rig.
This project studies how lung cancer cells with a mutation in a gene that regulates alternative splicing escape the immune system.
This project studies how type III CRISPR-Cas systems, which are immune systems of microbes, use RNA-guided signaling to control cellular proteins.
This project develops a workflow using nonlinear optics label-free imaging to capture metabolic and structural information from fresh prostate cancer biopsy samples.
